sections: Create a stopping ritual so work has a visible ending. Write tomorrow's first task on paper, close the tabs, put the charger away, change clothes, make tea, or step outside for five minutes. The ritual matters less than repeating it until your body recognizes the transition.

Not everything that looks like rest is restorative. Scrolling for an hour may leave you more stimulated than before. Useful rest usually lowers demand on your attention. A simple question helps: after this activity, do I feel more available to my own life?
